correctness.rationale: Dimension nine follows from injectivity at all q>=5. Leading-term footprints give exact uniform upper bounds for the first six ranks after exhaustive 511-subset enumeration; three-point interpolation sharpens the last three. Explicit factored sections and residual quadratic interpolation attain all maxima for every q>=5. A standalone checker recreates every footprint and confirms all 65,536 subsets over F5; finite checks corroborate the infinite-field proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete rank-by-rank classification of finite-field linear sections of the anticanonical F1 torus, including the structural jumps 2t+1 to 2t and t+2 to t+1 to t. The exact higher weights are not supplied by the minimum distance or by the different whole-surface code; the classification holds for every prime power q>=5.
